title: Performance idioms: memoization, lazy init, and batching
hook: Memoization caches pure function results. Lazy init defers expensive setup until first use. Batching combines DOM updates or Redis pipeline commands — three idioms that fix real production slowness without premature micro-optimization.

blocks.text: **Memoization**: cache `fn(args)` results keyed by serialized arguments — trade memory for CPU. **Lazy init**: `let instance; function get() { return instance ??= create(); }`. **Batching**: queue operations, flush once — `requestAnimationFrame` for DOM, Redis **pipeline** for N commands in one round trip. **Measure first**: Performance API, Lighthouse, clinic.js.

entries.plainDefinition: Cache function output by input key.
Group many ops into one flush.

blocks.text: Dashboard calling `formatCurrency` 10k times per render — memoize. Redis without pipeline: 100 sequential round trips vs 1 batched. Lazy init avoids opening DB connection at module import during tests.

blocks.title: Pure functions only
blocks.body: Memoize only when same inputs always same output — not fetch results without TTL.

snippet.label: Failure — memo impure fn
snippet.code:
const getTime = memoize(() => Date.now());
getTime(); getTime(); // same timestamp — wrong!
snippet.explanation: Impure functions cannot be memoized without TTL invalidation.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Memo without bound. Memoizing fetch. Lazy init without thread-safe pattern in Workers.

blocks.text: React useMemo/useCallback are framework memo. debounce vs throttle for event batching. SQS receive batch size vs processing batch. Measure LCP before optimizing JS — network often dominates.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Memoizes everything without profiling. Unbounded cache. Cannot explain Redis pipeline.

interviewTakeaways: Memoize pure functions with bounded cache.
Redis pipeline batches commands — one RTT.
60s: Profile first. Memoize pure fn with Map+limit. Lazy singleton connection. Redis pipeline for N GETs. rAF batch DOM writes.
Follow-up: memoize vs Redis cache for API responses?
commonPitfalls: Weak: unbounded memoize on user id.
Strong: bounded memo + pipeline + lazy init rationale.
